purpose: Dataset provenance and local acquisition record for the car-TSE target-speaker extraction pipeline.

selection.name: AISHELL-5
selection.role: real in-car speech, four-channel far-field audio, near-field references, AEC references, and cabin noise

selection.name: CAVEMOVE
selection.role: multichannel car impulse responses and driving-condition noise for acoustic augmentation

selection.name: ANIR Corpus - V class
selection.role: automotive impulse responses for future spatial/cabin augmentation; not speech or wake-word supervision
selection.license: Official page describes the download as free and requests notification/citation; verify terms before redistribution

selection.name: LibriSpeech
selection.role: clean enrollment and target speech for speaker-disjoint extraction training

selection.name: LibriMix generator
selection.role: reproducible clean/noisy two-speaker mixtures; local bootstrap generator is used to avoid the full multi-hundred-GB expansion
selection.license: MIT for generator scripts; source corpora retain their own licenses

selection.name: Fluent Speech Commands
selection.role: intent classification with speaker-disjoint command utterances

selection.name: Vehicle Interior Sound Dataset
selection.role: auxiliary vehicle-noise domain material; not speech supervision

selection.name: ReMASC
selection.role: English multichannel voice-command and replay-attack stress data; supplemental only, not same-driver wake/command evidence
selection.license: Repository README states the corpus is free for academic and commercial use; cite the ReMASC paper

not_downloaded.name: ASR-CabNois
not_downloaded.reason: full 2.47 GB download requires authenticated MagicHub access and carries CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 terms

not_downloaded.name: Nexdata 531-Hours In-Car Noise
not_downloaded.reason: commercial dataset; public repository/sample retained only

not_downloaded.name: iCarB-Voice
not_downloaded.reason: files are restricted (121.7 GB) and require an approved non-commercial research EULA; no access was assumed

reviewed_not_added.name: ICMC-ASR / AISHELL-5 public in-car corpus
reviewed_not_added.role: real multichannel in-car speech and far-field noise diagnostics
reviewed_not_added.reason: Mandarin and no continuous English same-driver Marvin protocol; challenge/data-agreement constraints require separate compliance tracking

reviewed_not_added.name: ICSRC 2022 intelligent-cockpit corpus
reviewed_not_added.role: real in-car Mandarin command/non-command and changing driving conditions
reviewed_not_added.reason: Mandarin, challenge-partition restrictions, and no personalized English wake-word sequence

reviewed_not_added.name: SPID spontaneous in-car dialogues
reviewed_not_added.role: controlled passenger dialogue, Lombard speech, and simulated driving-noise research
reviewed_not_added.reason: German, non-commercial research access, and no Marvin/enrollment/action labels

reviewed_not_added.name: CENSREC-3
reviewed_not_added.role: isolated driver words across speed and cabin-noise conditions
reviewed_not_added.reason: Not continuous personalized interaction; research/development distribution and remote-mic access conditions require review

reviewed_not_added.name: CI-AVSR
reviewed_not_added.role: Cantonese in-car commands with clean/noisy/OOD-noisy and audio-visual data
reviewed_not_added.reason: Language/input mismatch and repository license does not by itself establish asset-level terms for every processed file
